column3: (Anti-clickjacking header: GitHub Pages cannot send custom headers. Listed as a known gap on security.html)
(X-Content-Type-Options: GitHub Pages cannot send custom headers)
(Suspicious comments: false positive on the word "from" in ordinary comments)
(Server version: only the Python test server in CI, not the live site)
(CSP header: only on the test server 404 for sitemap.xml. Real pages set CSP in a meta tag)
(HTTP to HTTPS form post: only because the test copy is served over http. The live site enforces HTTPS)
(Storable content: public static pages are meant to be cacheable)
(frame-ancestors: not allowed in a meta CSP and GitHub Pages cannot send headers. Same known gap as 10020)
(Permissions-Policy: GitHub Pages cannot send custom headers)
(Modern Web Application: informational only, flags the noscript tag on the contact form)
(Dangerous JS Functions: the eval is the deliberate live CSP test in security.js, and the CSP blocks it)
(Anti-CSRF tokens: the contact form posts to Formspree and the site has no sessions to protect)
(Cross-origin isolation headers: GitHub Pages cannot send custom headers)
